summary: Fix LaunchAgent process discovery with paths containing spaces, reject mixed process ownership, and make login restoration tolerate worker lock reacquisition.

tasks.title: Validate full process command lines
tasks.change: Match the expected script against the un-split command string, reject every unmatched installer candidate before mutation, and cover paths with spaces plus mixed managed and unmanaged PIDs.
tasks.effect: Managed process discovery works under space-containing homes and installer preflight never unloads agents while an unmanaged candidate is present.

verification.risk_reason: Discovery governs persistent service shutdown and profile ownership; false negatives or false positives can interrupt services.
verification.test_reason: Existing coverage masked process discovery because the running process was not verified for paths with spaces and did not include mixed PIDs.
verification.subject: Space-containing paths and mixed process preflight
verification.procedure: Run bash syntax checks, all three requested shell integration scripts, and the specified three Vitest suites.
verification.pass_criterion: Paths with spaces are recognized, mixed candidates abort before any bootout, and all requested checks pass.

tasks.title: Restore the worker after completed lock checks
tasks.change: Keep lock checks before bootstrap, remove the post-bootstrap absence requirement, and simulate a restored worker acquiring the profile lock.
tasks.effect: A successful handoff exits successfully when the restored worker legitimately owns the profile lock.

verification.risk_reason: This coordinates the worker and Chrome over a shared browser profile lock.
verification.test_reason: The timing-dependent post-bootstrap lock reacquisition needs a deterministic regression test.
verification.subject: Successful login restoration with worker lock reacquisition
verification.procedure: Run the login shell integration script as part of the requested verification set.
verification.pass_criterion: The worker bootstrap is recorded, the worker lock exists afterward, and login exits zero.

verification: npx vitest run test/unit/agent-runtime.test.mjs test/unit/agent-worker.test.mjs test/unit/agent-gateway.test.mjs
risks: Actual macOS GUI and keychain behavior is outside this Linux shell-fixture verification.
